text:
jamie: FYI I merged nimblehealth/lora-quant into main — used q4_0 + per-channel rounding. starting the nimble quick-eval pack now (/evals run nimble-quickpack)
ashwin: nice, thanks. is tokenizer the same as prod? any vocab edits in the LoRA?
mia: tokenizer unchanged, used prod vocab. training log shows a handful of OOVs but nothing major.
jamie: eval started on our dedicated infra (g4dn-sim). will paste quick summary when done.
eval-bot: QuickEval: nimble-quickpack finished on main@nimble-lora-4bit
  summary: 75/90 checks passed, 15 flagged, 0 critical crashes
  regressions: avg entity-extraction F1 drop 2.8% (baseline 92.3 -> 89.5)
  high-delta cases: currency parsing, negative amounts, invoice-id hallucination up x1.8
  artifacts: /artifacts/nimble/1754329876/quick-eval-diffs.html
noah: 2.8% F1 drop on invoices is annoying. do we have per-field breakdown?
jamie: quick per-field from the pack:
  - amount: -4.6% F1
  - currency: -3.9% F1
  - invoice_id: -1.2% F1 but hallucinations up in free-text fields
  the model's generation entropy increased slightly after quant, esp. in tail tokens.
nashwin: could be quant noise on output projection. did we quantize output layers or leave them fp16?
mia: we quantized the whole model with the stock q4_0 flow. output linear remained quant'd.
jamie: repro prompt that failed (sanitized):
```
Customer: NimbleHealth
Task: extract invoice meta from OCR text
Input: "Invoice # 3421
Total: $1,234.56 USD
Date: 2025-01-08"
Expected: {"invoice_id":"3421","amount":"1234.56","currency":"USD"}
Model: returned invoice_id:"3421", amount:"1234.56 usd", currency:"US dollars", note:"charged on 2025-01-08"
```
noah: interesting — tokenizer casing leads to small generation diffs but shouldn't flip currency format. smells like softer logits on small tokens.
nashwin: options: 1) re-run with mixed quant (keep output/projection layers at 8-bit or fp16), 2) try PTQ per-channel for first linear, 3) fast canary (traffic split 5%) and monitor Console metrics / regression alerts.
jamie: I can do option (1) quickly — re-exporting with outproj in fp16; will run quickpack again.
mia: also suggest adding prompt-stable mapping in postproc for currency normalization as a mitigation while we iterate.
eval-bot: note: rollback threshold configured at 3% F1 drop for invoice pipeline (customer nimblehealth). current drop 2.8% — borderline.
ops-bot: created ticket #ML-1428: "nimblehealth 4bit LoRA quick-eval regression" assigned to jamie. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-1428
ashwin: keep canary gating strict. if next run >3% drop we roll back to previous model and schedule a lightweight A/B with per-layer quant.
jamie: running mixed-quant export now, will post results ~15m. :eyes:
mia: also add a tiny eval that checks currency canonicalization (exact match) to the quickpack — saves time next runs.
jamie: ack. will patch the eval pack and re-run. :thumbsup:
noah: thanks — if mixed-quant still shows issues we'll try a 8-bit outproj + 4-bit rest and re-run the pipeline.
jamie: noted, updating ticket with artifacts and plan.
